title: Stratos is spelled as Stratos Swarm spells it
notes: Stinkyscape #68's name is corrected to Stratos, the spelling #158 Stratos Swarm prints; S03 (#1860) had kept the designer list's swapped letters (R1860008). The name and #158's two texts only: no number, keyword, tag, pool or behaviour changes.

player.title: Stratos is spelled one way
text: The Stinkyscape Unit that Stratos Swarm fills your board with is now spelled Stratos, as the Swarm spells it. Nothing plays differently.
